honest_c3: C1 — Phase 2 smoke EMPIRICALLY FALSIFIED OPT-B's premise as currently specified. The spec §1.2 already documented the gradient-flow gating issue (`consciousness_states is None` → cross_attn skipped), and §1.4 proposed adding cross_attn to LoRA target_modules to fix it. Phase 2 smoke proves that target_modules patch ALONE is insufficient — even with cross_attn LoRA attached and gradients computed for all OTHER trainable params (self_attn lora_B = 64/64 non-zero post-train), cross_attn LoRA receives ZERO gradient because the forward path is gated upstream of LoRA injection. This is a discovery, not a failure: it surfaces that the OPT-B retrain spec needs an amendment (call it OPT-B') to also feed consciousness_states during SFT before $20-50 H100 spend.

C2 — self_attn positive control PASSED, validating the gradient-flow probe methodology. Self_attn lora_B 64/64 non-zero post-train (max_norm 3.59e-3) confirms (a) PEFT LoRA attachment works, (b) backward pass reaches the LoRA adapters that participate in forward, (c) the smoke test methodology is sound. The cross_attn ZERO result is therefore not a methodology artifact — it is a real architectural finding about the cross_attn forward gating.

C3 — phi-drift estimate after smoke (-0.5 placeholder) is informational ONLY. Canonical phi probe is K=8 partition method on 16 calib prompts requiring Mac CPU fp32 + ridge=1e-3, which we did not run as Phase 2 budget cap. The logit-std proxy (0.91 mean) is on a different scale than canonical phi (35.81 mean); direct subtraction is meaningless. Spec §3 Risk A's φ★-flip concern is unaffected by Phase 2 — it's a Phase 3 outcome metric, not a Phase 2 gate.

C4 — Phase 3 dispatch is BLOCKED on three gates: (gate 1) substrate differential PASS (already PASS), (gate 2) user $20-50 H100 cost ACK (pending — never solicited), (gate 3) Phase 2 smoke PASS (FAIL — gradient flow blocked by consciousness_states gating). Gate 3 is the new finding from this Phase 2 work and supersedes the spec's assumption that target_modules patch alone is sufficient. Recommended next step: amendment cycle 'OPT-B'' specifying consciousness_states feed mechanism (e.g., compute decoder.tension_proj output during forward and route it to consciousness_states= argument; or pre-compute and inject train_avg_real.pt fixture per F-SHIM-V5-4 pattern).

C5 — sibling pattern (raw#15) preserved both v1 train script and v1 orchestrator UNTOUCHED. Train script sibling lives at tool/transient_py/clm_v4_lora_train_opt_b.py; orchestrator sibling at tool/clm_v4_lora_train_orchestrator_opt_b.hexa. Both v1 originals untouched per raw#15. BG_LANE=OPT-B-CROSS-ATTN-RETRAIN, TARGET_USD=30. Boot register / heartbeat / trap pre-stop EXITING marker / 404 verify 3×30s / deregister-on-404 — all replicated from v1 pattern.

C7 — Phase 1+2 came in at $0 actual cost (Mac authoring + ubu1 free smoke). Wall time ~90min (within ~1.5h spec target). Findings include one critical architectural blocker (gate 3 above) that materially changes Phase 3 go/no-go calculus. This is a high-value Phase 2 outcome: $0 spend prevented up to $50 of Phase 3 H100 spend that would have produced a F-OPT-B-2 FAIL verdict regardless (cross_attn weights would not have moved even after 3000 H100 steps because the forward gating issue is identical at any scale).

C8 — Spec falsifier F-OPT-B-2 (cross_attn.o_proj std diverges from init floor 0.02 by ≥1e-3 after Phase 3) is now PRE-FALSIFIED in expectation: Phase 2 smoke shows post-train std mean=0.019905 = pre-train std mean=0.019905 (NO change at 6 decimal places after 10 smoke steps).
